Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the attachments.

Short answers up front:
- Yes, since Archon Holdings UK Ltd is a UK-registered entity, we need a completed W-8BEN-E (signed) for our vendor file to support foreign payee classification and claim any reduced withholding treaty benefits.
- We also need a copy of the company registration (certificate of incorporation) that matches the name on the W-8BEN-E, and a VAT registration extract (you attached that — thanks).

Can you please:
1) Complete and sign the W-8BEN-E (we accept DocuSign),
2) Upload the certificate of incorporation to our vendor portal, and
3) Confirm the legal entity name, address, and the US Tax ID/EIN if you still have one (some UK subsidiaries keep an EIN for legacy contracts).

If you prefer, you can complete the DocuSign W-8BEN-E link and I can trigger a manual review so AP can proceed. If all docs are received, our target is to release payment within 5 business days. If there is a delay in docs, we can consider a partial payment hold (we'll need finance approval).
